description: TinyLink v5.0: 4-Phase Enterprise & Edge Intelligence Suite

userStories.title: AI Edge Intelligence & Threat Shield Studio
userStories.description: As a creator, I want automated AI slug and tag suggestions, instant social preview metadata extraction, and automated threat and phishing detection before shortening.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/ai/suggest endpoint returns contextual slug recommendations and keyword tags based on target URL and title
POST /api/ai/metadata endpoint scrapes and summarizes target destination to extract or generate high-converting og:title and og:description
Pre-shortening threat scanner checks destination domain against suspicious keywords and blocks malicious URLs with a 400 error
Shorten Studio UI provides an 'AI Auto-Fill' button that populates slug, tags, og:title, and og:description in 1 click
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented generateAiSuggestions with POST /api/ai/suggest for contextual slug and tag generation. Built handleAiMetadata with POST /api/ai/metadata for automated OpenGraph title, description, and keywords extraction. Implemented isSuspiciousThreatUrl blocking deceptive and phishing URLs with 400 errors. Added AI Auto-Fill button to console Shorten Studio with automated slug and social preview populating.

userStories.title: Advanced Real-Time Analytics & Geo Heatmap Studio
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want an interactive global SVG world heatmap of visitor traffic, a live click stream feed, post-click conversion goal tracking, and one-click executive report exports.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive SVG world map renders visitor density across countries with hover tooltips and country click counts
GET /api/stream/clicks endpoint provides live click stream telemetry with country, device, referrer, and timestamp
POST /api/goals/track endpoint records conversion events (signup, purchase, download) tied to specific link slugs and calculates conversion rates
GET /api/analytics/:slug/export endpoint outputs formatted CSV and JSON reports of link performance and timeline telemetry
Analytics inspector modal displays the interactive world map, conversion rate scorecard, and report export buttons
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: Built interactive SVG world geo heatmap component and country click distribution. Added GET /api/stream/clicks endpoint with real-time click stream telemetry. Implemented POST /api/goals/track conversion goal recorder with conversion rate calculation. Built GET /api/analytics/:slug/export for RFC4180 CSV and JSON reports. Added Export buttons and Goals scorecard to inspector modal.

userStories.title: Developer Platform & Scoped API Key Studio
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to generate scoped API keys with granular permissions and per-key rate limits, verify webhooks with HMAC signatures, and explore an interactive API playground.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints POST /api/keys, GET /api/keys, and DELETE /api/keys/:id manage scoped API tokens with granular permissions (read:links, write:links, delete:links, read:analytics)
API key authentication validates key scopes and enforces tiered rate limits with X-RateLimit headers
Webhooks include HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-TinyLink-Signature header generated using secret signing key
GET /api/docs endpoint renders interactive OpenAPI documentation and test console with zero external script dependencies
Console provides API Keys management tab in Settings modal to create, view, copy, and revoke keys
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented POST /api/keys, GET /api/keys, and DELETE /api/keys/:id for scoped API tokens (tl_live_ prefix with SHA-256 KV storage). Added granular scope validation (read:links, write:links, delete:links, read:analytics) and per-key rate limiting with X-RateLimit-* headers. Built GET /api/docs OpenAPI 3.1 documentation and interactive testing console with zero external scripts. Verified HMAC-SHA256 signatures with X-TinyLink-Signature. Added Developer Platform & API Keys studio modal to console UI.

userStories.title: Custom Domain Multi-Tenancy Manager & Branded 404 Studio
userStories.description: As an agency owner, I want to manage multiple branded custom domains, configure custom root redirects and branded 404 pages per domain, and inspect domain resolution health.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints GET /api/domains, POST /api/domains, and DELETE /api/domains/:domain manage custom branded domains in KV
Request router dynamically matches Host/X-Forwarded-Host to configured domain settings
Each domain supports custom rootRedirect URL and custom branded 404 error page
Console provides Custom Domains manager tab in Settings modal with domain list, DNS status, and route settings
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: Built GET /api/domains, POST /api/domains, and DELETE /api/domains/:domain for custom domain management in KV. Integrated dynamic domain routing matching incoming Host/X-Forwarded-Host to configured domains. Enabled per-domain root redirect (302) and custom branded 404 HTML error page rendering with X-Custom-Domain header. Added Custom Domains Multi-Tenancy Studio modal to console UI.
